_comment: Written by the daily run. ideas: proposed briefs. watchlist: promising but under-evidenced. rejected: looked at seriously and dropped. Incumbents are App Store app ids.

watchlist.evidence: ~14 relevant low-star reviews 2026-09-08..10-29 in us, in, za, ar, br (incl. es/pt): 10 on free-tier cuts (slide/photo limits halved, templates/stickers to Premium), 3-4 on forced professional/public IG account. Crowded splitter category: Panoslice, SWVY, Seam, Crsel, Grid Square Cut, SwipeMix
watchlist.promote_if: >=15 relevant reviews after rescan AND a gap the existing carousel splitters don't fill (no account / one-time unlock / posts from any IG account); otherwise reject on 4.3 risk

rejected.reason: fix already crowded (TrialGuard, Trial Alert, TrialHero, Bobby, ReSubs); no subscription API on iOS; finance-adjacent; 4.3 risk high
AI inference cost drives the ads; fails Gate B economics; evidence mostly one storefront
background removal built into iOS; rest is billing disputes
needs caller/spam database and Call Directory extension
two-sided dating marketplace; fails Gate B
review scan found no recent complaints; paid charts only in tiny storefronts; generic workout category, high 4.3 risk
only 5 low-star reviews in 90d; crowded with Anki-compatible apps (AnkiApp, Noji, RemNote)
dropbox.com web already lets over-quota users get files out; API-dependent one-off export, no recurring value

~125 low-star reviews (sa, us, ae, gb, pk, my) on immodest ads while reading; killed by free ad-free Quran.com app (4.9, 33.9k), iQuran (4.8, 30.9k, no ads/no subs), Greentech Al Quran (4.8, 19.1k); 4.3 risk high
~51 low-star reviews on ads blocking prayer times/adhan; killed by Pillars (4.8, 5.6k, free, no ads), MAWAQIT (4.9, 6.3k), Pray Watch (4.8, 9.3k), iPray ($1.99, 4.8, 9k)
VN (4.8, 323k, free, no watermark) and InShot already fill it; video editor not a 14-day build
redesign backlash (~20 reviews); drawing engine not feasible in Expo/14 days
